policy: No test or parameter cell deleted; no skip or xfail added; exact answers refer to supplied rounded coordinates, not pre-rounding ideal motions.

entries.old: For every source-ring EE accepted by ee_cover, frozen normal dot cover normal > 0.5 and facet_normal3 with the same source label dot cover normal > 0.5; at least eight covers.
entries.new: Every source edge pair, including rejections, is checked against independent Fraction Newell/Gram arc validity, strictness, exact line parameters and exact in-extent status. Existing frozen-versus-cover >0.5 and cover count >=8 retained, plus frozen-versus-oracle >0.5. Canonical convex views separately check their complete strict EE label set and every facet_normal3 against an independent normal with dot >1-1e-12.
entries.why_not_weaker: The design separates general supplied face-ring covers from canonical convex facets. The old comparison mixed different geometries and label namespaces after rounded motions. Both legitimate APIs retain a full check, while existence/absence, parameters, strictness and label completeness are added. All original input cells remain.

entries.old: Select the ideal near-gap eight EE pairs in the original rotated input, require all to remain in extent after engineering-coordinate motion, and require a stable body_distance label.
entries.new: All 144 source edge pairs in both original and transformed inputs are checked against the independent exact oracle, including cover rejection and exact in-extent parameters; the complete accepted in-extent pair sets must agree. Existing physical gap checks remain. On both inputs body_distance's selected label must belong to the complete independent valid/in-extent label set; physical distance and frozen signed distance remain checked. Added an explicit unrounded yaw-stack analytic-eight gate.
entries.why_not_weaker: Rounding can move a true line intersection outside [0,1] or change exact local arcs, so forcing an ideal tie count or unchanged tie label would require an answer-changing noise band. The new gate checks every actual-input classification, not only eight selected pairs, retains metric assertions, and preserves the analytic eight-count assertion where its assumptions hold.

entries.old: Original endpoint is valid/in-extent at s=1,t=0.8; every rounded transformed endpoint is also required to yield an in-extent cover and small gap.
entries.new: Original endpoint validity, in-extent, small gap and analytic s=1,t=0.8 assertions retained. All transformed cells unconditionally solve independent Fraction Gram parameters and verify the line gap; production existence/rejection, strictness, exact params and in-extent compare with independent arc/Gram truth. A missing cover must be an oracle-proven exact arc rejection, not a skipped cell.
entries.why_not_weaker: The exact contract cannot turn a rounded off-endpoint or rejected arc into a valid in-extent cover. Every original cell remains classified and checked; rejected cells still have their independent line parameters and physical gap checked, while valid cells have exact rather than approximate parameter equality.

entries.old: No dedicated primal exact-construction versus unchanged Dual compatibility test.
entries.new: Four asymmetric nondegenerate yaw/rotation cells compare primal normal to Dual value to 1e-13 and a live derivative to centered finite difference to 1e-7, requiring a nonzero derivative.
entries.why_not_weaker: Additive gate; no prior assertion removed. Micro-crossing Dual construction is explicitly not claimed fixed.

documentation_only: Replaced historical module-level noise-band rationale with the exact supplied-input contract; existing frozen distance grid and ridge/wedge gates untouched.

baseline.note: maxfail=5; canonical/source-label mismatch followed by true micro-crossing frozen construction failures in rewritten exact gate

verification.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -X utf8 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_frozen*.py --maxfail=5 --junitxml=reports/codex/E5a_evidence/frozen_final.xml
